import { readFile, writeFile } from 'node:fs/promises';
import { beforeAll, afterAll, describe, test, expect } from '/Users/bobsingor/GitHub/cloudpdf-platform/oss/embedpdf/packages/core/signature/node_modules/vitest/dist/index.js';
import { createLocalEngine } from '/Users/bobsingor/GitHub/cloudpdf-platform/oss/embedpdf/packages/engine/main/dist/index.js';
import { validateSignatures } from '/Users/bobsingor/GitHub/cloudpdf-platform/oss/embedpdf/packages/core/signature/src/index.ts';
const directory = '/tmp/epdf-weak-nm-probes/p3-matched';
const manifest = JSON.parse(await readFile(`${directory}/manifest.json`, 'utf8'));
const certificate = new Uint8Array(await readFile(manifest.certificate));
const reports: any[] = [];
afterAll(async () => { await writeFile(`${directory}/engine-report.json`, JSON.stringify(reports, null, 2)); });
for (const runtime of ['wasm', 'native'] as const) {
 describe(runtime, () => {
  let engine: ReturnType<typeof createLocalEngine>;
  beforeAll(() => { engine = createLocalEngine({ runtime: { prefer: runtime } }); });
  afterAll(async () => { await engine.destroy(); });
  test.each(manifest.cases)('$id preserves certification integrity and reports the expected identities', async (fixture: any) => {
    const path = `${directory}/${fixture.file}`;
    const bytes = new Uint8Array(await readFile(path));
    const doc = await engine.open(runtime === 'native' ? { kind: 'layerFile', id: fixture.id, basePath: path } : {kind:'bytes', id:fixture.id, bytes}, {scope:['*']});
    try {
      const results = await validateSignatures(doc, {trust: {anchors: async () => [certificate]}});
      const analysis = await doc.signatures!.analyze({since: {signatureIndex: 0}});
      const page = (await doc.pages.list()).pages[0].ref;
      const annotations = (await doc.page(page).annotations.list()).annotations;
      const squares = annotations.filter(a => a.subtype === 'square');
      const weakCount = squares.filter(a => a.ref.kind === 'index').length;
      const names = fixture.action.includes('names');
      const deleted = fixture.action.startsWith('delete');
      const expected = ['control','rewrite'].includes(fixture.action) ? 'unchanged' : 'permitted';
      reports.push({runtime,id:fixture.id,action:fixture.action,layout:fixture.layout,docMdp:results[0].signature.docMdp,catalogCertification:results[0].signature.catalogCertification,allowsAnnotationModification:doc.security.allows('doc.annotate.modify'),summary:results[0].summary,integrity:results[0].integrity,cryptography:results[0].cryptography,trust:results[0].trust,modifications:results[0].modifications,weakCount,annotationRefs:squares.map(a=>({contents:a.contents,ref:a.ref})),findings:analysis.steps.flatMap(step=>step.findings)});
      expect(results).toHaveLength(1);
      expect(results[0].signature.docMdp).toBe(3);
      expect(results[0].signature.catalogCertification).toBe(true);
      expect(results[0].integrity).toBe('valid');
      expect(results[0].cryptography).toBe('valid');
      expect(results[0].trust).toBe('trusted');
      expect(doc.security.allows('doc.annotate.modify')).toBe(true);
      expect(squares).toHaveLength(deleted ? 3 : 4);
      expect(weakCount).toBe(fixture.layout==='direct' && !names ? squares.length : 0);
      expect(squares.map(a=>a.contents)).toEqual(deleted ? ['weak-0','weak-2','weak-3'] : ['weak-0','weak-1','weak-2','weak-3']);
      expect(results[0].modifications.verdict).toBe(expected);
    } finally { await doc.close(); }
  });
 });
}
